title: MemoryVLN: From Ego-Aware Memory Representation to Cross-Context Memory Reuse in Vision-Language Navigation
title_zh: MemoryVLN：从自我感知记忆表示到视觉语言导航中的跨语境记忆复用

paragraphs.en: MemoryVLN提出了一个统一的记忆驱动型导航系统，解决了长时程轨迹中的记忆复用问题。 Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have shown strong potential for embodied vision-language navigation (VLN), yet their performance degrades on long-horizon trajectories due to context-length limits, redundant historical observations, and unstable spatial alignment across time. These issues make it difficult to both compress long navigation histories and reliably reuse past spatial experience. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MemoryVLN}, a unified memory-driven navigation system built around memory construction and management. During memory construction, \emph{Long Sequence Compression} employs forgetting-curve-inspired temporal sampling to preserve dense recent evidence and sparse yet representative distant observations under a limited token budget. \emph{Ego-Aware Memory Representation} further integrates 2D semantic tokens, 3D geometric tokens, and 6D agent poses, allowing each memory to encode both what was observed and where it was observed. During memory management, \emph{Hierarchical Memory Bank} maintains in-episode and context-level memories through cross-context warm-start and confidence-controlled write-back. \emph{Memory Enhancement} then retrieves the Top-$K$ relevant memories according to the current navigation state and fuses them with the current visual tokens. Together, these mechanisms transform raw navigation history into compact, spatially grounded, selectively retrievable, and reusable navigation experience. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate consistent improvements over the state-of-the-art baselines by a substantial margin (i.e., 2\% and 6.5\% in successful rate).
paragraphs.zh: MemoryVLN提出了一种统一的记忆驱动型导航系统，解决了长时程轨迹中的记忆复用问题。大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在具身视觉语言导航（VLN）中展现出强大潜力，但由于上下文长度限制、冗余的历史观察以及跨时间不稳定的空间对齐，它们在长时程轨迹上的性能会下降。 这些问题使得同时压缩长导航历史并可靠地复用过去的空间经验变得困难。 为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了\textbf{MemoryVLN}——一种围绕记忆构建与管理建立的统一记忆驱动型导航系统。 在记忆构建阶段，\emph{长序列压缩}采用受遗忘曲线启发的时间采样方法，在有限的令牌预算下保留密集的近期证据和稀疏但具有代表性的远期观察。\emph{自我感知记忆表示}进一步整合了二维语义令牌、三维几何令牌和六维智能体姿态，使每个记忆单元既能编码观察到的内容，也能编码其观察位置。 在记忆管理阶段，\emph{分层记忆库}通过跨上下文热启动和置信度控制的回写机制，维护单次任务内和上下文级别的记忆。\emph{记忆增强}则根据当前导航状态检索Top-$K$相关记忆，并将其与当前的视觉令牌融合。 这些机制共同将原始导航历史转化为紧凑、具有空间基础、可选择性检索且可复用的导航经验。 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上的广泛实验表明，该方法相比当前最先进的基线模型有显著且一致的性能提升（即成功率分别提升了2\%和6.5\%）。
